grammar.summary: 本课学习表语前置的倒装与 rescue 场景被动。

points.title: 被动叙事（打捞场景）
points.explanation: The plane was wrecked / it was restored 被动语态串起"坠机-挖出-修复"全过程。

points.title: restored 表修复的系表结构
points.explanation: was restored beautifully = 被精心修复，restore 的被动表"被复原"。

examples.en: It has been restored by volunteers.
